g.text: 256 fresh authored worlds · original Granite 4.0-1B · two fixed training seeds
Bars: complete-world accuracy; adapter rows average seeds. Original/blind outputs are shared.
Intervals: thick 95%, thin family-adjusted 98.75%; paired world bootstrap stratified by task (10,000 draws).
This is a same-template mechanism study, not public-benchmark or larger-model performance.
